concept: Full-body concept art of a monstrous four-legged beast for a video game: a huge demonic wolf with charcoal black fur, glowing orange eyes, a wide snarling mouth full of sharp teeth, bony spikes along its spine and a long bushy tail. Rig-ready pose: it stands on its four legs, straight and slightly apart, every leg clearly visible and separated from the others, the tail held out behind it away from the legs, the head up. Seen strictly from the front: it faces the camera straight on. One single creature, centered, the whole body visible. Plain uniform light grey studio background, no floor, no ground, no pedestal, no cast shadow, soft even studio lighting.
desc_courte: huge demonic four-legged wolf beast, charcoal black fur, glowing orange eyes, snarling toothed mouth, bony spine spikes, long bushy tail
